messages.subject: Markdown to PDF
parts:
Is it possible to convert Markdown to PDF while keeping the same styling as HTML? I like the style of Markdown output to HTML, but don't like the LaTex output to PDF, so I'm looking for a solution that would basically convert Markdown to HTML and then HTML to PDF through R commands.  Is this possible?

Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: 5f8b51633aa2f2a1
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Markdown to PDF
parts:
What you're seeing in your browser is a function of HTML + CSS + any quirks of your browser's rendering engine. 

To get a PDF which looks the same, your best bet is probably to use the browser's save to PDF feature.
